verdict.rationale: Anrok's API calculates tax per jurisdiction, resolves addresses to taxable jurisdictions, returns valid customer tax IDs to collect, and manages registrations across jurisdictions, all of which can feed compliant invoice data into a billing system (anrok-docs-10,11,25,38,41). However there is no evidence of Anrok itself generating an invoice with required locale-specific fields (seller VAT/registration number formatting, invoice numbering rules, etc.) or explicit documentation of invoice-field mapping beyond tax amount and tax-ID data. Missing for 10: explicit invoice template/field generation, documented locale-specific invoice compliance rules, and confirmation that seller registration numbers are pushed onto the invoice itself.
